newsitem.title: UK: Bunzl to buy American Filtrona.
newsitem.headline: Bunzl to buy American Filtrona.

text.p: British plastics group Bunzl Plc said on Wednesday it agreed to buy American Filtrona Corp for a total of about $178 million cash, or $46.52 per share.

The letter of intent came less than a week after American Filtrona terminated a deal to be acquired at the same price by WBT Holdings LLC, a company owned by several trusts of the family of the late Walter Bunzl.
Under that deal, WBT had planned to sell American Filtrona's bonded fibres business to Bunzl for $72.45 million after buying the company.
Bunzl said the Bunzl family trusts owning about 46 percent of American Filtrona's shares had agreed to vote in favour of the new agreement.
American Filtrona has two trading divisions, bonded fibres and plastics, which made a pretax profit of $19.4 million in 1996 on sales of $193 million.
Bunzl planned to finance the deal from its resources.
"American Filtrona is an excellent fit with Bunzl, and this acquisition is in the best interests of both companies," Bunzl chairman Anthony Habgood said in a statement.
